The
$4.50 Theater Company
(
Japanese
:
劇団4ドル50セント
,
Hepburn
:
Gekidan Yondoru Gojussento
)
is a Japanese
theater company
[
1
]
established in 2017 by two Japanese producers
Yasushi Akimoto
and
Max Matsuura
of
Avex
.
[
2
]
It is operated by Avex AY Factory, LLC, a subsidiary of Avex.
[
3
]
History
The name of the company was taken from the total amount of coins
Janis Joplin
, of whom producer Yasushi Akimoto is a fan, was holding in her hand when she died.
[
2
]
The company started with 31 members, selected through auditions attended by approximately 5,000 people.
[
4
]
Ninety percent of the selected members had no acting experience at all.
[
4
]
Despite being a theater company, its members also perform various other activities such as modeling, participating in television shows, and music.
[
4
]
On October 30, 2017, the company announced that its members would appear in the advertisement for the PlayStation 4 version of
Call of Duty: WWII
.
[
5
]
